sar.narrative: On the review date, real-time risk models flagged transaction 3506725 in the amount of $1,000.03 as highly suspicious with a risk score of 0.90. The transaction was initiated as an unauthorized online card-not-present purchase outside the customer's normal historical behavior. Investigation by the fraud operations team confirmed the activity as fraudulent card-not-present exploitation. Consequently, the transaction was declined, the card was blocked to prevent further loss, and a formal case was generated. Because the total financial exposure of $1,000.03 exceeds the mandatory reporting threshold of $1,000, a Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) is required. All supporting evidence and transaction identifiers have been documented for regulatory compliance.
